preferred.Foundry_transition: Start with modeled2030 Foundry operating profit divided by actual2030 Products revenue, then hold that ratio after2030 and scale dollars with actual Products revenue. This is not a reported Foundry margin. No extra expansion toward3% in preferred case.

selection_rationale: YTD2026 DCAI product-profit improvement4.5B explains approximately92% of operating-profit improvement4.883B; preserve a real product-led recovery rather than reverting mechanically to2025.

Full-YTD anchor includes the low-margin Q1 and strongerQ2/Q3. It permits roughly3.2pp of CPU margin erosion from the pooled recent-quarter residual, avoiding an assumption that the most recent scarcity-period economics must last.
Premium platform mix is the majority of reported ASP improvement; a return to old all-in ASP is therefore not the same as removing a scarcity surcharge. Its exact durable portion is undisclosed.
Other20% is an allocation/forecast assumption, not observed profitability. Lower purpose-built gross margin does not identify its operating margin.

2027 Other60% is retained because it is only9.8% above annualized assumedQ4 exit; later growth slows to30/20/15%. Other includes products beyond custom silicon, so the purpose-built triple statement is not used as a numerical guide for all Other.

Post2030 CPU2%unit+2%ASP growth is an explicit normalization convention. There is no primary-company forecast identifying Intel CPU units in2031–40; the former6.04% revenue path is favorable rather than validated.

Near-term50% groupGP response is centered on the CFO annual40–60% incrementalGP rule. With nonmanufacturingopex fixed in a scenario, deltaEBIT=deltaGP. It is not a measured CPU unit elasticity, and weaker absorption can worsen lost-sale flow-through.
The existing2030 Foundry turnaround remains a substantive forecast. Holding its resulting profit/Products ratio avoids an additional automatic manufacturing-margin improvement after2030.
accounting_rules: Near-term50% response is totalgroup including manufacturing; assigning it to Products while holding displayedFoundry is a presentation allocation. Do not add a separate absorption penalty for the same revenue miss.
From2031 the component margin/Foundry engine replaces the near-term totalgroup response. Do not carry an extra old49-to40% decremental path on top.
Changes in internal transfer prices alone change Products and Foundry equally and oppositely; groupEBIT is invariant.

CorporateSBC and unallocatedR&D remain deducted once; groupR&D is not added again to segments that already contain it. NCI is an ownership cash-flow claim after operating profit, not a margin improvement.
